race.comment: WOLVES' DEN (7) just missed two back then got a long way back last time and was one-paced to the line, the jockey reporting to the stewards that he felt the gelding needed more ground. Gets that here and gets a chance to atone. BIVVY (3) was placed on debut then quickly out to a mile in a richer maiden last time. Has upside and the extra ground is a plus. Improver. Same goes for BELFAST BOY (2) who is a two-start maiden with the blinkers added. Wound up strongly and can only be improved. JONQUIL (11) was course and distance placed two back and rates highly on that run. Worth including in all multiples.
